_about: Thinking fillers spoken while the LLM thinks. classes -> phrases with sampling weights (higher = more common). Every phrase is hedged: it says the assistant is looking, never that it will or can. 'minimal' is the one-or-two-word tier for medium asks; 'none' means stay quiet.

minimal.desc: a medium-length ask: a sentence is too much, silence is wrong. one or two words.

echo_templates.desc: Used only when the gate says yes and the echo slot confidence is high (>= 0.7). {slot} is the 2-5 word noun phrase from echo.py, pronouns already flipped.

mix.note: with a confident slot, pick an echo template this often, else the class phrase; keeps it from echoing every turn

stage2_phrases.desc: Runtime-only (no model). Spoken while reasoning or tool-call parts stream and no text token has arrived. Max two fillers per turn total, skip once text arrives, never speak reasoning verbatim.

topical.desc: optional: regex keyword grab from the last ~200 chars of reasoning, filled into {topic}; only a safe noun-ish word list, never a raw span
